nativeBaseline.reference: authored status/busy relationships plus native progress where applicable

library: provide reusable built-in loading presentation hooks without creating application async state
preserve native progress semantics rather than fabricating progress values
provide a custom-content styling hook without forcing custom visuals into a closed variant enum
remove non-essential continuous motion for prefers-reduced-motion and retain forced-colors visibility
consumer: own request/job lifecycle, completion, failure, retry, cancellation, progress data, and timing policy
author aria-busy/status relationships when users need loading feedback
hide decorative indicators/placeholders from assistive technology when equivalent semantic feedback is provided separately
label native progress where its meaning is not otherwise clear
ensure custom loading visuals preserve equivalent semantics and reduced-motion expectations

notes: Loading is feedback presentation, not an async orchestration runtime.
Built-in visual variants do not imply different async lifecycle states.
The former standalone Skeleton product unit is superseded by Loading structured-placeholder presentation.
